Class AnimalDAO

java.lang.Object
com.trashslammers.model.AnimalDAO
All Implemented Interfaces:
IAnimalDAO
public class AnimalDAO extends Object implements IAnimalDAO
Saves and loads admin-added animals using the animals table in the SQLite database.
